# Signal Loom revision decision
Date: 5 February 2026

## Control change
The rotary dial was replaced by a pressure pad as the main control. The dial is retained only in the experiment archive and is no longer the active input.

## Reason for the control change
The pressure pad was selected because repeated dial movement caused abrupt jumps in the visual ribbon during bench trials.

## Surface change
The glass screen was replaced by a fabric diffuser. Glass is no longer part of the current display.

## Reason for the surface change
The fabric diffuser was chosen to reduce the distracting reflections recorded in the first bench setup.
